subject: AWS co-sell handoff: Xenith Health intro & joint plan
messages:
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: samantha.lee@xenithhealth.com, paul.turner@amazon.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell handoff: Xenith Health intro & joint plan

Hi Samantha and Paul —

Thanks for taking the time earlier. Per our call, I wanted to put everyone on a short thread to kick off the AWS co-sell handoff and propose a quick joint-account plan so we can align on next steps before a formal kickoff.

Quick context: Xenith is evaluating using Redwood Inference to power an LLM-assisted triage and clinical decision support feature. They are targeting an internal pilot with ~10k monthly active users and have strict PHI considerations; they'll likely deploy in a VPC via Redwood Private. Paul, AWS flagged this as a good co-sell candidate.

Proposed immediate asks:
- 30–45 minute intro call next week with Xenith solutions + AWS AM + Redwood sales/solutions (agenda below).
- Agree on a Mutual Action Plan (attached) owning responsible parties and timing.
- AWS to identify the regional SA who can join to validate architecture assumptions.

Proposed agenda for intro call (30 min):
1) Intros & success criteria (5 min)
2) Xenith current architecture & compliance brief (5–7 min)
3) Redwood solution overview + deployment options (8–10 min)
4) Next steps & MAP ownership (5 min)

I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan and our co-sell playbook to accelerate alignment. Please suggest times that work — I'm available Mon/Tue mornings PT.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Xenith_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_aws_co-sell-playbook.pdf (pdf)

From: samantha.lee@xenithhealth.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, paul.turner@amazon.com
Cc: solutions@xenithhealth.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell handoff: Xenith Health intro & joint plan

Hi Olga, Paul —

Thanks for the intro and the MAP. This looks promising. A couple of quick notes from our side:
- Compliance: we require SOC2 evidence and prefer KMS integration for keys. We can share the questionnaire but will want the AWS SA to confirm network/VPC expectations.
- Pilot scope: 3 clinicians initially, then scale to 50 over the next quarter if metrics look good.

Availability: Tue 2027-04-06 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 2027-04-07 09:00–10:00 PT work for our solutions team.

Can Paul confirm if an SA can join one of those times? Also — who should own the first draft of the technical checklist?

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Digital Ops | Xenith Health
samantha.lee@xenithhealth.com
